newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PPC awarded limestone mining licence.
newsitem.headline: PPC awarded limestone mining licence.

text.p: South Africa's Pretoria Portland Cement Co Ltd has been granted a mining licence for new limestone reserves in the Eastern Cape province, it said in a statement on Wednesday.

While no detailed plans were yet available, PPC said in a statement the reserves at Grassridge, some 40 km from Port Elizabeth, were sufficient to support a one million tonne per annum cement facility for at least 40 years.
Managing director John Gomersall said quarrying at the site would start within the next two years as the existing quarry at Loerie had a limited life at current tonnages.
The new find would also lower group limestone input costs, Gomersall said.
Further announcements would be made as plans were finalised in the months ahead, the statement said.
